entries.en: Seventeen-year-old Tom Davidson hasn’t left his home since he was 15.
entries.zh: 17 岁的汤姆·戴维森从 15 岁起就没离开过家。

entries.en: The last time he went out was two years ago.
entries.zh: 他上一次出门是两年前。

entries.en: He was walking to catch a bus when he was hit on the head by a sign falling from a building.
entries.zh: 他正走去赶公交车，这时被一块从楼上掉下来的招牌砸中了头。

entries.en: He spent more than two months in hospital and doctors told him he was lucky to be alive.
entries.zh: 他在医院住了两个多月，医生告诉他能活下来很幸运。

entries.en: The accident left Tom with agoraphobia: the idea of being outdoors makes him feel extremely anxious.
entries.zh: 这场事故让汤姆患上了广场恐惧症：一想到待在户外，他就极度焦虑。

entries.en: The problem is that Tom loves travelling.
Before his accident, Tom spent most weekends exploring his home city of London by bus, underground train and his scooter, and he looked forward to holidays abroad with his parents.
entries.zh: 事故前，汤姆大多数周末都会乘公交车、地铁或骑小型摩托车探索家乡伦敦，也期待和父母去国外度假。

entries.en: Now the idea of driving in a car to France or taking a plane to Italy terrifies him.
entries.zh: 现在，一想到开车去法国或坐飞机去意大利，他就害怕。

entries.en: However, there is a way that Tom can still visit the most remote corners of the world without leaving the security of his home: Google Maps.
entries.zh: 不过，有一种办法能让汤姆不用离开安全的家，就“走”到世界上最偏远的角落：谷歌地图。

entries.en: In the last year and a half, Tom has visited every country in the world where Google Maps has been and taken photos.
entries.zh: 在过去一年半里，汤姆已经“走访”了谷歌地图覆盖并拍摄过的世界上每一个国家。

entries.en: Using ‘street view’, he has walked down the streets of the world’s most famous cities, he has seen all the world’s most amazing geographical features and he has visited places in the world that he didn’t know existed: all of this from the comfort of his home.
entries.zh: 借助“街景”，他走过世界最著名城市的街道，看过最惊人的地理景观，也到访过他以前不知道存在的地方：这一切都是在舒适的家里完成的。

entries.en: Tom’s virtual travel is more than just a hobby – it has become an art project.
entries.zh: 汤姆的虚拟旅行不只是爱好——它已经成为一个艺术项目。

entries.en: He has taken more than 5,000 screenshots of places he has visited and last week, there was an exhibition of his best photos at a school near his home (but of course, he didn’t go).
entries.zh: 他为自己“到访”的地方截了 5,000 多张图，上周家附近的一所学校还展出了他最好的照片（当然，他没有去）。

entries.en: Tom also hopes that his online journeys will help him eventually to overcome his agoraphobia.
entries.zh: 汤姆也希望这些在线旅程最终能帮助他克服广场恐惧症。

entries.en: As he discovers more places that he wants to visit one day, he is becoming more and more determined to leave his home.
entries.zh: 随着他发现更多将来想去的地方，他离开家的决心也越来越坚定。

entries.en: And his dream, if he can, is to work in the travel industry, for example as a flight attendant or a tour guide.
entries.zh: 如果可以，他的梦想是在旅游行业工作，比如当一名空乘或导游。
